title: Public Utilities Act
verified_how: the statutes register itself could NOT be reached (nslegislature.ca refused the connection - see access_notes), so in-force status is unverified and is recorded as unclear. The title and citation were verified instead on the Government of Nova Scotia's Office of the Registrar of Regulations site on 2026-09-23: fetched https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regs/punspower.htm, which states it is made under Section 118 of the Public Utilities Act and gives the enabling Act's citation as 'R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 380'; the Act also appears as a live heading in the official 'Regulations by Act' index at https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regsbyact.htm, which lists Acts with regulations currently in force
notes: Rates, tariffs and billing for electricity, gas and water utilities; verified via the Nova Scotia Power Incorporated Regulations. A HUMAN MUST CHECK this one: Nova Scotia restructured its energy regulator in 2024, the Public Utilities Rules (N.S. Reg. 290/1992) are now shown as made under Section 20 of the Energy and Regulatory Boards Act, S.N.S. 2024, c. 2, Sch. A, and the Registrar's index files the Public Utilities Act under the 'Energy and Regulatory Boards Tribunal'. The substantive rate-and-billing statute still appears to be c. 380, but the split between it and the 2024 Act should be confirmed on nslegislature.ca.
